001package com.studentgui.test;
002
003import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
004
005import java.time.LocalDate;
006import java.util.List;
007
008import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
009import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
010
011import com.studentgui.apphelpers.Helpers;
012import com.studentgui.apphelpers.SqlGenerate;
013
014/**
015 * Basic integration tests for the Database helper using the on-disk sqlite
016 * created in the project's application data folder. These tests are small and
017 * intentionally exercise CRUD paths used by the UI pages.
018 */
019public class DatabaseTest {
020
021    @BeforeAll
022    public static void init() throws Exception {
023        Helpers.createFolderHierarchy();
024        SqlGenerate.initializeDatabase();
025    }
026
027    @Test
028    /**
029     * testStudentCreateAndFetch - TODO: describe this method
030     */
031
032    public void testStudentCreateAndFetch() throws Exception {
033        int sid = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateStudent("Test Student A");
034        assertTrue(sid > 0);
035
036        int ptId = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.getOrCreateProgressType("TestType");
037        assertTrue(ptId > 0);
038
039        String[] parts = new String[] {"P1","P2","P3"};
040        com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.ensureAssessmentParts(ptId, parts);
041
042        int sessionId = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.createProgressSession(sid, ptId, LocalDate.now());
043        assertTrue(sessionId > 0);
044
045        int[] scores = new int[] {1,2,3};
046        com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.insertAssessmentResults(sessionId, ptId, parts, scores);
047
048        List<List<Integer>> results = com.studentgui.apphelpers.Database.fetchLatestAssessmentResults("Test Student A", "TestType", 5);
049        assertNotNull(results);
050        assertTrue(results.size() >= 1);
051    }
052}
